title: Python: DIO/DAO/DIS carry link signatures
notes:
Epic with children - track through sub-issues project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.6.9.1.1.{2,3,4}
2026-08-26 verification: production LinkLayer signs every outgoing frame and verifies signature/replay before delivery, so DIO/DAO/DIS inherit authenticated control handling. Focused suites: 189 passed. Full python link+rpl suites: 1394 passed, 11 skipped. Targeted/source Ruff and source mypy pass. Umbrella remains open because child .3 (vectors) is blocked and child .4 (cross-validation) remains open; .3's note may have a stale dependency reference because .2 is now closed.
close_reason: Python DIO/DAO/DIS ride production LinkLayer frames with S=1/SI=1 and a 48-byte Schnorr MIC; unsigned copies return ReceiveError.UNSIGNED before any DODAG/DAO/DIS mutation. Independent oracles: RFC 6550 DIS/DIO/DAO bodies, ICMPv6 type 155 codes 0/1/2, link-01 LLSec bits, and test/vectors/reference_schnorr48.py. New suite python/tests/rpl/test_rpl_control_link_signatures.py: 12 passed. Forced over open children .3 (vectors) and .4 (cross-check), which remain separately tracked.
